webDesignChoices: Keep species comfort, systemic temperature injuries, attached fire and anatomical burns separate.
Connect actual movement, rescue, recovery, death and item/carcass conservation before tuning rates.
A deterministic Web self-extinguish schedule differs from the native random job-selection gate.
No random death-on-downed, no secondary frostbite and no extreme-air burn are explicit prototype omissions if not implemented.
A simplified weather-only wildlife exit condition does not reproduce native seasonal-temperature departure.
